name: Arlandastad Group AB (publ)
summary: Arlandastad Group AB (publ) is a Swedish real estate enterprise that conducts its business through three primary divisions: Property Development, Property Management, and Operating Companies. The company's core focus involves identifying promising land locations and subsequently developing them. As of December 31, 2021, its portfolio included approximately 1.3 to 1.4 million square meters of investment properties. Founded in 2005, the company's headquarters are situated in Arlandastad, Sweden.
